scope: Phase 5 current indexed long-fuzz campaigns: source identity for target, local codec subtree and reviewed dedicated dependency closure, with broad shared infrastructure/configuration differences separately disclosed. Not a final-whole-tree fuzz assertion.

index.status: Per-module source snapshots; shared integration continues and final phase acceptance is pending. Superseded campaigns remain auditable.

constraints_observed: Only Python/read-only source inspection; no Git commands, compiler, tests, fuzz or performance runs.
Only fuzz-source-audit.json and fuzz-source-audit.md are written.
Original campaign evidence and freeze manifests are unchanged.
method: Select index campaigns whose status is exactly passed; retain superseded labels separately and require one active campaign per target.
Verify referenced compressed JSON/log SHA-256 against the index, decode JSON, compare command and zero exit, and require indexed fuzzer seconds >= 610.
Map targets to actual codecs, include every current and snapshot .rs path in each codec subtree, recurse explicit fuzz #[path] helpers, and add reviewed cross-codec dependencies.
Resolve format helper aliases from formats/mod.rs and source imports. Group-specific helpers remain in module identity scope; legacy_common is tracked separately as a broad shared helper.
Compare current SHA-256 with the original source dictionary without assuming absence from a git-ls-files snapshot means absence from that build.
Keep model/bitmap/charset, resources/report/error, registry/transport and Cargo metadata changes separate; unrelated formats do not fail a campaign.
Verify three later aggregate snapshots independently; they supplement integration evidence, not replace old fuzz source dictionaries.
Rehash read current files and index at audit end to detect changes during inspection.

limitations: SHA identity establishes listed source files, not branch coverage, safety proof, full-format conformance, external dependencies or identical toolchain/linker output.
Per-module snapshots precede some shared integration changes. No claim that all campaigns fuzzed one identical final working tree.
An absent snapshot path is a provenance gap. The source may have been present and compiled while untracked; these records cannot establish its contemporaneous contents.
Transport exercises RAW/BDF/SSFN public transport profiles, not all native registry formats or all model-budget/CLI APIs.
Broad shared files may contain feature-disabled or unrelated code. Raw file hash differences do not establish which changed bytes affected a target.
This covers the current phase-5 index only, not superseded campaigns, other phases or phase-6 work.
Only files in reviewed scopes and three supplementary source manifests are rehashed; the filesystem is not an atomic snapshot.
